title: redactFailure redacts detail values but not keys, so a revealed credential used as a key leaks
resolution: redactFailure redacts keys with the same function and joins the values of keys that become equal in order; contract section 7.4 and the requirement Run redaction by credential value; tests that failed before the fix

title: Sequential split and join replacement breaks overlapping occurrences, redacts inside markers, grows the output, and hides a touched shape secret's suffix
resolution: Occurrences are found in the original text, merged when they overlap or touch, and replaced by one marker each; a word where they touch a shape secret is redacted whole; regression tests for each case that failed before the fix

title: An adopted execution must request the credential again but cannot hold a valid launch authorization after its grant expires
resolution: Contract section 7.3 defines the re-delivery ownership check and its refusals with the launch authorization reasons; requirement Re-delivery to an adopted execution with an adoption-after-expiry scenario; item 12 and 18 tests in section 9

title: A rotation can replace the token, so a re-delivery after adoption reveals a value other than the one the running harness uses
resolution: Section 8.1 refuses a rotation with conflict unless the slot is revoked and unreserved; revocation and removal are never blocked and cancel the slot's attempts (coordinator-confirmed); requirements and scenarios for both

title: The device-login refusal contradicts the unchanged harness-account-pools requirement that accepts any declared subscription mechanism
resolution: A harness-account-pools delta modifies Subscription account slots to accept only a deliverable mechanism, by D6 subscription-token, with a scenario for a declared device-login slot

title: The requirement lets the device-login restriction lapse when a later item defines a format, while the contract revisits it only if item 35 overturns D6
resolution: Subscription token delivery only now ties the restriction to item 35 overturning D6, as the contract and design do

title: The L9 evidence says no file imported REDACTED from scheduling at the base and counts the packages wrongly
resolution: The record names the scheduling account pool test as the one importer and its migration, names the four private packages, and records a reproducible multiline import check and the root package's bin-only publication

title: The make verify task is unticked although the record shows it passing
resolution: Task 3.2 is ticked with its revision bf7c0335, and a re-run after the pass 1 fixes is listed as a remaining gate
